title: Social Work Careers in Australia | IHM School of Social Work
desc: Explore 13 areas of social work practice in Australia, from mental health and hospitals to policy and research. Find where a BSW can take you.

blocks.t: Where a social work degree takes you.

blocks.p: Thirteen areas of practice, one versatile qualification. Explore the settings, roles and pathways open to Bachelor of Social Work graduates in Australia.

blocks.alt: Social work students with a community placement partner

blocks.t: One degree opens every one of these doors.

blocks.p: The four-year IHM Bachelor of Social Work prepares you for all of these fields.
